newsitem.title: UK: HK STOCKS IN LONDON FLAT EXCEPT FOR HSBC.
newsitem.headline: HK STOCKS IN LONDON FLAT EXCEPT FOR HSBC.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks trading in London were hovering around their Hong Kong close on Thursday on the lack of follow-through buying after a sharp rally overnight, but HSBC featured after being pulled higher by hefty gains in the London bank stocks.
The London Reference Index was up 47.01 points at 16,720.28 by 1422 GMT and HSBC was trading HK$2.3 higher than its Hong Kong close.
The Hang Seng had soared overnight on record turnover, jumping 258 points or 1.5 percent.

"Turnover of HK$34 billion was the highest ever in Hong Kong last night but most of the business was coming from local investors and there was no follow-through in London," one trader said. "HSBC was up on the back of the FTSE, but we saw no business in anything else."
